cta.section.title: Start
cta.section.body:
Five ready-made paths.
Start with the first task and let each step unlock the next.
philosophy.subtitle: The platform is designed so you can start easily and grow step by step without unnecessary complexity.
philosophy.point1.title: Practice before theory
philosophy.point1.desc: Every lesson should leave you with something you actually built or tried.
philosophy.point2.title: A system, not chaos
philosophy.point2.desc: Each skill connects to a complete learning system.
philosophy.point3.title: AI as a partner
philosophy.point3.desc: Learn to build with AI—not to use it randomly.
philosophy.point4.title: Visual clarity
philosophy.point4.desc: Cards, clear steps, and readable paths—without text overload.
ecosystem.subtitle:
You won't just watch explanations.
You'll learn, apply, use tools, and get AI help at every step.
ecosystem.pillar1.title: Hands-on learning
ecosystem.pillar1.desc: Every lesson comes with a small task you do yourself.
ecosystem.pillar2.title: Structured thinking
ecosystem.pillar2.desc: Understand the big picture—not scattered facts.
ecosystem.pillar3.title: AI in every lesson
ecosystem.pillar3.desc: A smart assistant explains and helps when you get stuck.
ecosystem.pillar4.title: Five connected paths
ecosystem.pillar4.desc: Pick the path that fits your goal and start there.
ecosystem.pillar5.title: Build something real
ecosystem.pillar5.desc: Apps, automation, analytics, and ideas you can actually ship.
ecosystem.pillar6.title: Real launch
ecosystem.pillar6.desc: From idea to a product or system you can use.
ecosystem.tiers.title: One journey, four clear stages
ecosystem.tiers.subtitle: From understanding AI to building with it. Each stage unlocks the next.
ecosystem.tier1.title: Start
ecosystem.tier1.desc: See the full picture before any path.
ecosystem.tier2.title: Use AI
ecosystem.tier2.desc: Content, data, and work decisions—without code.
ecosystem.tier3.title: Run systems
ecosystem.tier3.desc: Smart automation and workflows that run on their own.
ecosystem.tier4.title: Build products
ecosystem.tier4.desc: For people who want to ship SaaS and AI apps themselves.
